name: A Simple Request
label: Quest
description: A Simple Request: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Lord Jorach Ravenholdt has requested your presence. The matter is secret, and I cannot say any more.
Ravenholdt Manor is located in the Hillsbrad Foothills -- look for a path in the mountains northwest of Durnhold Keep.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Welcome, welcome, welcome! Please, friend, have a seat and discuss a simple matter with me.
You see, friend, I've recently lost something dear to me, and to put it bluntly, I want it back at all costs. There's something in it for you, don't worry about that! Oh yes, something very nice.
Now, what say you friend... Are you up for some adventure?
